benchmark: AI Visibility Benchmark V1 - Public Search Proxy Consolidation
purpose: Consolidate public-search proxy work before direct AI-platform execution. Public search is not direct ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao output and must not be used as proof of AI citation or recommendation.

observedSummary.historicalOwnEntityObservation: One China-to-Thailand non-brand query previously surfaced an own page, but it did not reproduce in repeatability checks.

brand.publicSearchProxyRole: identity/disambiguation checks handled separately; direct AI benchmark still required

dominantGapClassification: DISCOVERY: canonical first-party pages exist but are not stably surfacing for non-brand public search intents
EVIDENCE: independent external entity evidence remains weak
IDENTITY: generic brand wording creates disambiguation pressure; strong identifiers must remain consistent
ANSWERABILITY: core canonical pages are already materially stronger than the current discovery signal, so duplicate page creation is not the primary next action

decision.requiredMethod: Use the frozen 50 prompts unchanged; capture actual platform answer, entity mention, recommendation status, position if applicable, citation URLs, description accuracy, competitors, testedAt, and notes. Do not substitute web-search proxy results for platform output.

guardrails: No fabricated citations, reviews, media, partnerships, addresses, licenses, warehouses, prices, transit guarantees, or customer counts.
A search-engine result is not an AI-platform citation or recommendation.
A single observed result is not stable discovery until repeatable.
Keep the 50-prompt set fixed for Before/After comparison.
